card.name: Small words right before 'therapy' or 'treatment'
card.fires_on: Short linking or modifier words (to, with, standard, general) that come just before an expected 'therapy' or 'treatment' in drug-label text. Typical cases are 'responded to', 'refractory to', 'adjunct to', 'treat with' and 'institute general'.
